verdict.rationale: ZCode's marketing claims multi-agent collaboration toward complex goals, plus a Goal feature for continuous planning, execution and verification. That is the product's own capability in the direction of autonomous multi-agent work. Nothing documents launching parallel fleets on separate tasks or runs lasting hours or days. missing for 10: documented launch and management of multiple parallel agents on different tasks, evidence of long-running (hours/days) autonomous sessions, concurrency limits or controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days
